concept: Growth of Political Ideas and Political Organisations upto 1885
question: Where was the first unit of the Singh Sabha formed in 1873?
solution:
__
 
• The correct answer is **Amritsar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ​ Britishers in 1849 annexed the Khalsa Raj.
 
• Khalsa Raj was an independent Sikh kingdom in Punjab founded by Ranjit Singh in 1799.
 
• Thereafter the Christian missionaries gradually started to increase their activity. 
 
• The last Sikh who was converted to Christianity in 1853 was Dalip Singh.
 
• The local religious traditions were under the threat and in response to this Sikhs initiated the Singh Sabha movement which sought to revive Sikh doctrine.
 
• The first unit of Singh Sabha was formed in Amritsar in 1873.
